description: 'A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing' found 12-month time-series momentum across equity, bond, commodity and currency futures worked in every decade since 1880. Approximation: futures-based ETFs, long-only, holding every market with a positive 12-month return. Falsified if it does not cut drawdowns versus an equal-weight mix.
title: Managed-futures trend · 12-month · 23 futures ETFs (after Hurst, Ooi & Pedersen 2017, AQR)
